answer: Horsehair and brass wire lie sorted on the sieve-maker bench, ready for the frame. Proof of sieve-maker via mesh sieve tally — a sieve the sieve-maker meshes only after 263 sieves sift true without one tearing at the mesh, each meshed by the sieve-maker himself. sparrow bends the beech rim round and pins it tight. comet stretches the mesh across the frame and tacks it even all round. summit tests the sieve with fine meal and checks nothing slips through. Two hundred and sixty-three sieves must sift true without one tearing at the mesh, and the next still tears where the hair ran thin.
